entities.summary: Titus Statilius Severus was a Roman senator of the 2nd century AD. He was ordinary consul in 171 with Lucius Alfidius Herennianus as his colleague. Fragments of an incomplete inscription found in Cales and dated to 172–180 provide details about his career.
